resources.string: Hold space to talk, release to recognize and type (overrides the space long-press behavior). Choose the engine in Settings → Voice models
Replace the hide-keyboard button at the right of the toolbar with a mic: tap to start talking, tap again to recognize (engine in Settings → Voice models); long-press it to hide the keyboard

If Azure recognition fails, recognize the same recording with offline SenseVoice (model must be downloaded); if online translation fails, use offline translation (Offline Translator must be installed). Only ever falls back from online to offline
Speak recognized text with Azure TTS
Tap the mic to finish · max 60 s
Correct voice input with the LLM

After recognition, the default LLM (its fast model) fixes homophones, typos and punctuation before the text is typed. Sends the recognized text to the model service; not used in password or incognito fields. Falls back to the original text if it fails or takes longer than 8 s
